objects.name: Detection technique coverage: zscaler-virus-download-threat-blocked
objects.description: The following analytic identifies attempts to download viruses that were blocked by Zscaler within a network. It leverages web proxy logs to detect blocked actions indicative of virus download attempts. Key data points such as device owner, user, URL category, destination URL, and IP are analyzed. This activity is significant as it helps in early detection and remediation of potential virus threats, enhancing network security.
